subject: HTML Page Network D3 Output Problem

messages.author: d48c25039d976859
messages.subject: HTML Page Network D3 Output Problem
parts:
I'm trying to display a simple network on html page but its working correctly. My directory structure code are below. Any ides why it isn't working?

 <application-dir>
|-- www
    |-- index.html
|-- server.R




index.html

<html>

<head>
  <script src="shared/jquery.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
  <script src="shared/shiny.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
  <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="shared/shiny.css"/>
</head>
 
<body>
  <h1>HTML UI</h1>
 
<div id="force" style="width:100%; height:500px" class="simpleNetwork html-widget html-widget-output"></div>

</body>

</html>





Server.R

library(shiny)
library(networkD3)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

output$NT <- renderSimpleNetwork({
 
# Fake data
Source <- c("A", "A", "A", "A", "B", "B", "C", "C", "D")
Target <- c("B", "C", "D", "J", "E", "F", "G", "H", "I")
NetworkData <- data.frame(Source, Target)

# Create graph
simpleNetwork(NetworkData)
})

})

Any help would be appreciated.

Thanks,

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: HTML Page Network D3 Output Problem
parts:
networkD3 has JS/CSS dependencies that aren't being imported; they're automatically imported when you use ui.R to assemble your UI.

We've just released a new version of htmltools (v0.3) that lets you write HTML templates but still define inputs, outputs, and htmlwidgets using R:

ui.R
-----
htmltools::htmlTemplate("template.html",
force = simpleNetworkOutput("force") # or whatever
)

template.html should be alongside ui.R (or you can put it anywhere else in the app dir and pass a relative path to htmlTemplate). Inside of template.html make it just like your index.html but don't include the CSS/JS references for Shiny at the top, instead in <head> include {{ headContent() }}. And wherever you want that network output, say {{ force }}.

We are still writing the docs for this feature, hopefully that's enough to get you started.
